title: See what you can do — arena screen
slide_intent: Adapt movement and typography to an architectural display so a message remains readable across a curved surface.
strategic_value: O2’s bubble behavior can connect small-screen branding to the arena environment associated with its entertainment offer.
demonstration: A curved external arena screen shows bubbles crossing a blue gradient, a centered See what you can do line appearing, and the bubbles continuing after the line clears.
practical_value: Give the main phrase a readable hold within a moving ambient field when composing for a large display.

content_islands.name: Architectural context
content_islands.spec: Retain the cylindrical structure, vertical fins and arena surroundings around the display.

content_islands.name: Animated screen
content_islands.spec: Wrap the blue field around the curved screen, move bubbles through it and hold the white phrase across the middle.

reference_purposes.Expression: The clip applies the soft bubble motion and blue gradient at architectural scale.
reference_purposes.Application: The identity is demonstrated on a curved arena screen rather than an isolated flat canvas.
